call_points.text: With a larger part of the festive season falling in the second half of the year, the outlook remains encouraging.
FY27 revenue growth guided at 12%, EBITDA margin at 14% (including 150 bps retail impact)
FY27 capex at ₹100 Cr, with ₹40-50 Cr allocated to retail expansion
Consumer sentiment positive for festive season despite Adhik Maas postponement in Q1
Retail expansion funded through internal accruals; debt-to-equity at 0.24 as on 30th June '26
Real estate project: construction to start in Q2FY27, expected completion in 24 months
Management guides for approximately 12% revenue growth in FY27.
Store count is targeted to reach approximately 70 stores across ZECODE and DEVO by the end of FY27.
Fabric contributed 80%, garments 15%, and others 5% to FY26 revenue mix.
EBITDA margin guidance maintained at ~14% with a 150 bps retail drag.
Management remains cautiously optimistic about long-term growth prospects while pursuing measured retail expansion.
Total store count reached 27 ZECODE outlets and 17 DEVO stores in FY26.
Fabric contributed 80%, garments 15%, and yarn & others 5% to Q4 FY26 revenue composition.

timeline.summary: Ramesh D. Poddar, as Promoter, declares no encumbrance on 67.44% stake (30,598,404 shares) in Siyaram Silk Mills Limited as of March 31, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹853.29 Cr (+15.9% YoY), net profit ₹97.78 Cr (+35.7% YoY).
Siyaram Silk Mills Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Investor/Earnings Call on 21st May 2026 discussing Q4FY26 and FY26 performance at www.siyaram.com.

Siyaram Silk Mills reported Q4 FY26 total income of ₹871 Cr (+16.1% YoY) and PAT of ₹95 Cr (+30.6% YoY), announced a total FY27 dividend of ₹16 per share, and outlined plans for a residential real estate project in Dombivali.
On June 1, 2026, Siyaram Silk Mills informed the exchange about a proposed inter-se promoter share transfer of 2.27% stake by way of gift.
Q1FY27: Revenue ₹466 Cr (+16.4% YoY), PAT ₹11 Cr (+144.4% YoY); retail revenue ₹30 Cr, store count at 49
Siyaram Silk Mills reported Q2FY27 total income of ₹827 Cr (+15.1% YoY) and PAT of ₹75 Cr (-13.8% YoY), with retail store count reaching 61.
